verdict.rationale: The Claude API docs describe a first-party browser playground in the Console where users can try out the API, so the product does offer an interactive, runnable surface. The evidence does not show that the API reference itself is interactive or that its pages embed runnable examples; the llms.txt evidence only confirms .md mirrors of the full API reference. missing for 10: interactive API reference pages with embedded runnable/try-it examples, evidence linking the playground to reference endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: In the Console, you can use playground (platform.claude.com/playground) to try out the API in the browser and then generate API keys on the API keys page
.md mirrors of every docs page including the full API reference
